title: Udyam (MSME) registration
summary: Free, paperless registration of the enterprise as an MSME on the Udyam portal, based on self-declaration.

authority.name: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

sources.title: Udyam Registration : Zero cost, No Fee and Free Registration of MSMEs
Udyam Registration Form – For New Entrepreneurs (With Pan Yes)

steps.title: Register on the Udyam portal
steps.description: MSME registration is fully online, paperless and based on self-declaration: Aadhaar verification with OTP, then PAN verification; investment and turnover details are taken from Government databases.

documents.name: Aadhaar number (OTP verification)
documents.note: No documents or proof are required to be uploaded.

documents.name: PAN of the enterprise
documents.note: PAN and GSTIN (as applicable) are required with effect from 01.04.2021.

fee.note: Zero cost, no fee: registration is free of cost.
